title: Cervical stitch (cerclage)
what: The doctor puts a strong stitch around the cervix so it does not open too early. This is usually done through the vagina under anesthesia.
why: When the cervix is weak and there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm birth.
duration: the procedure usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; the hospital stay is usually 1 to 3 days
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
If you had a preterm birth before
If you had problems with anesthesia

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Swabs, blood tests, and an ultrasound. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthesiologist
prepare.text: Usually general anesthesia or a numbing injection in the back is used. The anesthesiologist will talk with you.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually you do not eat or drink for several hours before. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Your things
prepare.text: Pads, comfortable clothes, slippers, and a phone charger.

bring: Your pregnancy record and test results
Things for 1 to 3 days in the hospital
steps: You change, and an IV line is placed in your vein
You lie on the exam table
The doctor places a stitch around the cervix
The doctor checks that the stitch holds
You go to your room, and you and your baby are monitored
feel: After the procedure, you may feel pulling low in your belly
Light bleeding may happen in the first few days
You may feel sleepy after anesthesia
after: Your doctor will tell you how active you can be
Sex is usually not recommended. Ask your doctor
The stitch is usually removed at 36 to 37 weeks, or earlier if labor starts
red_flags: Contractions or regular pain low in your belly: call emergency services

faq.q: Can I give birth with the stitch in?
faq.a: No. The stitch is removed before birth. If contractions start, go to the maternity hospital right away.

faq.q: Is the procedure dangerous for my baby?
faq.a: Like any procedure, it has risks. The doctor does it when the benefit is greater than the risk.

reminders.text: Cervical procedure tomorrow. Bring your pregnancy record. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
